column1: # index.tsv · the memory desk's fact index. One row per settled fact.
# Five tab-separated fields: key <TAB> aliases (| separated, may be empty)
# <TAB> answer <TAB> source <TAB> checked (YYYY-MM-DD, or - for unchecked).
# Keys and aliases match case-insensitively; write them the way a session
# would ask. Keys must not begin with the reserved words add or check.
# Keep every answer to one line; anything longer lives at the source and the
# answer says what the reader will find there. A fact has one home: the row
# either IS the home (a one-liner) or points to it, never both.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. memory/mem check is the
# integrity gate; run it before committing an edit here.
# The rows below describe the desk itself. They are keepers, not demo data:
# after adoption they answer the questions new sessions ask about the desk.
